lines.text: Brihat Jataka

lord is Mercury the profession is related to writing (clerical),
mathematics, literature and painting etc.
जीवांशे द्विजविबुधाकरादिधर्मै: काव्यांशे मणिरजतादिगोमहिष्यै:।
सौरांशे श्रमवधभारनीचशिल्पै: कर्मेशाध्युषितनवांशकर्मसिद्धि: ।। 3 ।।
If the aforesaid lord is Jupiter, the profession is connected
with Brahmins, deities, dealing with horses etc, and from
religion (as priest etc). If the said planet is Venus, he earns
from diamond etc, silver, coins, buffalos and highly placed
ladies. If it is Saturn, one earns from hardworks, killing of
animals etc, carrying burden, low class handi work etc.
मित्रारिस्वगृहगतैग्रहैस्ततोर्थांस्तुङ्गस्थे बलिनि च भास्करे स्ववीर्यात्।
आयस्थैरुदयधनाश्रितैश्च सौम्यै: सचिन्त्यं बलसहितैरेनकधा स्वम्।। 4 ।।
If the said lords of the 10th house occupy a friendly sign,
the income accrues from friends, if placed in inimical sign it
accrues from enemies, if placed in their own sign from their
own effort, if Sun is strong in his exaltation one earns through
one's own effort. If the benefic planets are strong and occupy
the lagna, the 2nd and 11th house, they are instrumental in
giving income from different sources.
इति श्रीवराहमिहिरकृते बृहज्जातके कर्माजीवा नाम दशमोऽध्याय: ।। 10 ।।
Thus ends the tenth chapter on Nature of Profession in
Brihat Jatak composed by Varahamihira.
